name: sieve
title: usesieve.com
shortDescription: Sieve offers clean, human-validated data solutions with just a few lines of code. It is designed for businesses needing reliable data extraction and cleaning, particularly useful for hedge funds and financial analysts. An example use case is extracting and verifying financial data from various reports, saving significant time and resources.
pros: Simple integration with a few lines of code
Custom integrations for niche use cases
cons: Potential high cost for custom services
Limited information on specific data sources used
